scores.evidence: There are 3 can-do objectives with Bloom levels, and each has questions with objectiveId: o1 has q0–q2, e1 and e2; o2 has q3, e3 and e4; o3 has q4, e5 and e6. The writing in o2 (「書ける」) and the design in o3 (「設計できる」) are only produced in the practice sections with self-checks (p1-checklist, p2-checklist). The exam only asks the learner to choose, and two of its items can be answered by convergence (see active).

hook-b1 is a concrete scene in 3 sentences (「機能の実装を任せている途中で、急ぎのバグ修正を頼まれました…「毎晩、テストの失敗を報告してほしい」」) that sets up both halves of the lesson. The ungraded predict q0 targets the same-folder misconception, every wrong option has feedback, and the answer is the third option.

The prerequisites list 第2回, 第4回, 第6回, 第7回 and 第8回 plus Git basics. The text recalls them where they are used (「第7回の[[サブエージェント]]」, 「Manualモード（第2回）」, 「MCPサーバー（第8回）」). Terms are defined before use: s1-defs and s4-defs, 非対話的実行 in s3-lead, and glosses for トークン（token…）, シェル（shell…）, CI（継続的インテグレーション）, PR（プルリクエスト） and API（Application Programming Interface）. The glossary entries match s1-defs and s4-defs.

measure.mjs reports 「prose 2265 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 2653 · practice reading 1246 · questions 11 · practice sections 2 · est 20.0 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 20)」, so the lesson is within budget but exactly at the cap. lint --strict reports 0 warnings. headless is dense: 非対話的実行, シェル and four new flags (s3-table) in one segment. unattended-where adds 2 terms that are never practiced.

Each practice task comes after a worked example. s2-code with s2-steps gives 5 subgoal-labelled steps, each with its reason (「消すと、ブランチごと消えます」). s3-code with s3-table explains each flag (「付けないと…」), and s4-prompt maps a model prompt to the 4 points in its expect. No faded example comes between these and practice; p1-model is almost the same as s3-code.

Four of the five segments have an inline check, and each check applies the idea to a new case: q1 (login text vs payment config), q2 (「モジュールが見つからない」), q3 (bare `-p` in CI) and q4 (5 quiet days). Each has hints and per-option feedback. But exam items e3 and e5 can be answered by convergence: each distractor changes exactly one part, so the option that shares the majority part in every slot is the key (must-fix).

All 7 misconceptions in the brief are addressed by distractors or text: same folder (q0, q1 d), dependencies (q2), the `-p` default (q3 b/c/d), broad `Bash` (s3-pitfall, e3 b), the trust prompt (e4 d), prompts are not enforcement (s4-enforce, e6), and a quiet day vs a failed read (q4 d). Every feedback fixes the error in 2 sentences or fewer and gives a reason (「autoモードで始まるのは、ターミナルやVS Codeの対話セッションです。」).

There are no images and no decoration. The comparisons in s1-table, s3-table and s4-table are 「〜なら、…」 lists, a defensible choice for mobile. The worktree layout (main folder, `.claude/worktrees/<名前>/`, branch `worktree-<名前>`) is spatial and is described only in text (ex-feature expect); a small diagram would help.

Both tasks are hands-on, with expect, a hint → troubleshoot ladder, a model answer (p1-model, p2-prompt expect) and a checklist (7 and 4 items). p-run also asks for a prediction first. The second task is not a transfer task: p2-before is the same nightly-test scenario as practice 1, and its model answer repeats p1-model's prompt.

summary-points (4 points) comes after the exam and matches the four key ideas. summary-next gives a reflection task (「成功の条件を1文で書いてみましょう」) and the next lesson. There are 7 retrieval flashcards, and summary-ask offers 3 askTutor suggestions.

The 3 findings confirmed in audit-cc-09-parallel-automation.json are fixed in the current text: s1-lead (「並列の作業を助ける道具を2つ紹介します」), s3-table (「確認が要る操作を、聞かずに拒否します（読み取りは動きます）」) and summary-points (「モードを指定しない `claude -p` は」). Other claims match facts-cc-09-parallel-automation.md and cross-lesson fact 8, are cited, and are pinned to versions (v2.1.302, v2.1.304). The section title 「並列の3つの方法」 still counts methods, which the docs do not support (niceToHave).

The lesson keeps です・ます, is warm (「名前だけで十分です」) and has no banned phrases. Two terms vary: the permission prompt is 「承認が要る」 in s3-mode and q3 but 「確認が要る」 in s3-table, e3 and pc-mode, and the practice place is 「練習用リポジトリ」 in s2-code but 「練習用フォルダー」 in p1-task.

The only declared locale (jp) is complete, and no text is baked into images. The link text is descriptive (「公式ドキュメント（非対話的実行）」), and the plain-text fields (checklist labels, askTutor) contain no markdown.

mustFix.issue: e3 can be answered by convergence without knowing the flags. Each distractor changes one part of the key (b: `Bash`, c: `bypassPermissions`, d: no `--bare`). `--bare`, `Bash(npm test *)` and `dontAsk` each appear in 3 of 4 options, so a test-wise learner picks a, the only option made of all three majority parts. The item gives its answer away.
mustFix.fix: Keep the ids, array order (b, c, d, a), answer ["a"] and option a. Balance the parts so each value appears in exactly 2 options. Option b: md 「`--bare` ＋ `Bash` ＋ `bypassPermissions`」, feedback 「`Bash` は全コマンドを通し、`bypassPermissions` は確認を飛ばします。」. Option c: md 「`Bash(npm test *)` ＋ `bypassPermissions`」, feedback 「`--bare` がないとフックや `.mcp.json` が動き、`bypassPermissions` は確認を飛ばします。」. Option d: md 「`Bash` ＋ `dontAsk`」, feedback 「`--bare` がないとフックや `.mcp.json` が動き、`Bash` は全コマンドを通します。」. Then re-run lint (sentence length) and measure.mjs (est must stay ≤ 20).

mustFix.issue: e5 has the same convergence cue. b differs from the key only in success (「いい感じ」), d only in failure (「調べられなくても空の配列」), and c only in permission (「更新とコミットも」). JSON format, 「編集はしない」 and 「理由を返して」 each appear in 3 of 4 options, so a is the only all-majority option, and the o3 exam item can be answered without applying the 4 points.
mustFix.fix: Keep the ids, array order (b, d, a, c), answer ["a"] and option a. Option b: md 「「更新できるパッケージを調べて、いい感じにまとめて。編集はしない。調べられなければ『更新なし』と返して」」, feedback 「「いい感じ」では完了の形が決まらず、読めない日も「更新なし」になります。」. Option d: md 「「名前・今の版・最新の版をJSONの配列で返して。なければ空の配列。必要なら更新とコミットも。調べられなくても空の配列で返して」」, feedback 「報告だけの作業に更新やコミットを頼み、調べられない日も空の配列になります。」. Option c: md 「「更新できるパッケージを調べて、いい感じにまとめて。必要なら更新とコミットも。調べられなければ理由を返して」」, feedback 「「いい感じ」では完了の形が決まらず、報告だけの作業に更新やコミットを頼んでいます。」. Each value then appears in exactly 2 options. Re-run measure.mjs (est ≤ 20).

niceToHave: factual doubt / consistency, section parallel: the title 「1. 並列の3つの方法を選び分ける」 contradicts s1-lead 「並列の作業を助ける道具を2つ紹介します」. The docs count five ways to run agents and call worktrees and background commands supporting tools (audit-cc-09-parallel-automation.json, s1-lead verdict). Suggest the title 「1. 作業に合わせて並べ方を選ぶ」.

practice-audit p2-before: the weak prompt is the same nightly-test task as practice 1, so the learner can copy p1-model and does not transfer the 4 points. Consider another domain, e.g. 「毎朝ログを見て、エラーをいい感じにまとめておいて。原因がわかったら直しておいて。」, and adapt the p2-prompt expect model answer to match. Offset the added text so est stays ≤ 20.

p2-prompt: the prompt asks Claude to check 「費用の上限（--max-budget-usdなどで決めているか）」 and permissions, but the only variable is 「直した依頼文」, so Claude cannot see the flags and will always report them missing. Rename the variable to 「直した依頼文とコマンド」 (in both the prompt and vars[0].name) with hint 「例：claude --bare -p '…' --allowedTools "Bash(npm test *)" …」.
s3-check q3 option a (「Manualモードで始まり、承認が必要な `npm test` が拒否される」) nearly repeats s3-mode. Set its md to 「`npm test` が実行されないまま終わり、テスト結果のない要約が返る」.
s3-code: the prompt 「リンターの警告を数えてください。」 does not name the allowed command. Replace line 2 with `  "npm run lint の警告を数えてください。" \` so the prompt and `--allowedTools` visibly match.

unattended-where: no objective covers s4-table (GitHub Actions, クラウド・デスクトップの定期タスク, `/loop`) and no question assesses it, yet it adds 2 terms. Either add one inline question (「パソコンを閉じている夜間に毎日動かしたい」 → クラウドの定期タスク) after a matching cut, or shorten it to one sentence inside unattended.

Visual: a 4–5 node diagram of the worktree layout (cc-practice-09 → `.claude/worktrees/feature-a` / `bugfix-b`, branches `worktree-feature-a` / `worktree-bugfix-b`, merge back), with caption and alt, would support s2-steps on mobile.

Terminology (the ja-editor decides): use one term for the permission prompt (s3-mode and q3 「承認が要る」 vs s3-table, e3 and pc-mode 「確認が要る」), and one name for the practice place (s2-code 「練習用リポジトリ」 vs p1-task 「練習用フォルダー」).
p1-steps-write p-run: 「プランでなくAPIの料金です（第10回）。」 is terse, and 「プラン」 can be confused with プランモード. Consider 「Pro・Maxなどのプランではなく、APIの料金がかかります（第10回）。」, if est allows.
Load is at the cap (measure.mjs est 20.0, estMinutes 20). Any addition, including the e3 and e5 fixes, needs a matching cut.
summary: This is a full review. The lesson moved to content/courses/claude-code/lessons/ and its courseId changed, and the review gate no longer accepts the earlier review chain recorded under the vibe-coding path. validate reports 0 errors and lint --strict 0 warnings, and measure.mjs reports prose 2265 and est 20.0, which matches estMinutes 20. The biggest strength is a clear arc with strong misconception work: hook → worktree example → safe `claude -p` → the 4-point prompt, and every distractor targets a misconception from the brief, with short corrective feedback. The audit's three confirmed accuracy fixes are in place. Two items must be fixed: exam items e3 (o2) and e5 (o3) can be answered by convergence, because each distractor changes one part of the key. Rebalance their options as specified. The mean is 3.31, and every criterion scores 3 or higher.
